title: Automatic Sweep: Pausing or Disabling Your Sweep Program
summary: Explains how to pause or disable an Automatic Sweep program: pausing stops new sweep transfers (review how $0.00 applies while paused), disabling turns off sweeps and removes active configurations, with $0.00 charges ceasing after cancellation is processed. Also covers reverse sweep behavior—Yes when active, but does not occur while paused or disabled.
faqs: How do I pause my Automatic Sweep program, and what happens to new sweep transfers?
When my sweep program is paused, how does the $0.00 charge apply?
What happens if I disable my sweep program (active configurations and sweeps)?
When do $0.00 charges stop after disabling—immediately or after cancellation processing?
Does reverse sweeping (Reverse sweeps = Yes) occur while the program is paused or disabled?
keywords: Pause sweeps / no new sweep transfers
$0.00 charges cease after cancellation is processed
Reverse sweeps Yes / does not occur while paused or disabled
